title: Bhavai Pot Balance Dance
tagline: Dance to the drum and balance a tower of pots.
description: Bhavai Pot Balance Dance turns the folk pot dance of Rajasthan into a balance and rhythm game. Slide a finger to steer the dancer onto footprints in time with the drum while a growing tower of clay pots sways on her head. Eight courtyards, spins, wind, Practice, Watch and Learn, an in-app Rules book, portrait and landscape play, synthesised sound, no ads.
howToPlay: Slide a finger sideways: the dancer follows it.
Be on the footprint when it reaches the gold line on the beat.
Catch the tower's lean by moving under it; smooth moves keep it quiet.
Spins push the tower: lean the other way first, then settle.
Keep still for a pot beat to add another pot to the tower.
Watch and Learn dances the act for you and thinks before each phrase. Pause it any time.
On a keyboard: Left and Right steer, P pauses, H hints in Practice.
